verdict.rationale: Remote documents its own CLI on an official developer page. It covers looking up employments, acting on time off and expense requests, downloading payslips, and managing webhook subscriptions. Every command can emit JSON and list commands export CSV, which suits scripted and agentic use. Missing for 10: documented installation and authentication flow for the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: look up employments, act on time off and expense requests, download payslips, and export any list straight to a spreadsheet.
Every list command exports to CSV with `-o csv`, and every command can emit JSON, so the output drops straight into spreadsheets and scripts.
